tree.name: The Shapes Gallery
tree.notes: The S3 test dungeon (devdocs/map_studio/S3.md): one of every room shape the build learned in S3, joined so a walk goes through all of them. An L-shaped hall with a pillar and a dais, a bent corridor drawn as a path, a flight of eight steps up to a gallery, a closet behind a hinged door, and a ramp down into a cave whose outline bends inward.

rooms.name: Tunnel that climbs round a bend
rooms.notes: A path room with a slope: the floor climbs from 0 at the path's first point to 256 at its last, the ceiling with it. Corner strips (`ends`) on walls whose foot and top rake.

rooms.name: Head of the climbing tunnel
rooms.notes: Small surfaces: a flight with wooden treads and a coping on its side walls, a threshold of its own in the doorway from the tunnel.

rooms.name: Tunnel with a pointed crown
rooms.notes: A section whose top is one point, 16 over its neighbours: a vault's crown.

rooms.name: North dome
rooms.notes: The pool is a sunken level marked as water in objects.yml (floors), with the world's liquid texture as its surface, which is what the game draws as water; the kerb round it is a parapet whose path ends where it began.

rooms.name: South dome
rooms.notes: A hall under a hipped ceiling whose north end stands upright on the wall it shares with the north dome. The mouth between the two is one mouth in two parts: open from wall to wall up to the eaves (480), and a gable 512 wide from the eaves into both upright ends (to 920), with nothing between the parts.

rooms.name: Pit under a false floor and an unseen one
rooms.notes: A pit 256 deep behind a doorway at the apse's floor height. Over its south half lies a floor that is drawn and not solid (`solid: false`): the party falls through it. Over its north half lies one that is solid and not drawn (`visible: false`): the party stands on nothing that can be seen.

rooms.name: Ledge the carrying block rises to
Passage with a gate block, a sinking plate and a carrying block
Guard post

platforms.notes: A lectern whose top slopes up to the north, with a switch plate lying on it (objects.yml switch:lectern, `side: top`).

rooms.notes: Things placed and things clicked: a monster that stands at its post (objects.yml monsters), an item on the floor (items), a podium that is clicked and does not move (a platform with an id as a click event's source) and a notice on the wall that is read (a wall panel with an id).

rooms.name: Gully that closes to the north
rooms.notes: A dais across the foot of the bank: a level that stands higher than the uneven floor everywhere under it (the floor runs on under it; its sides reach down to the floor's lowest place along its rim). A cave cut across its length by the wall to the next: a level floor that rises as a bank to the north wall, under a roof that leans down to it. The bank and the leaning roof take a surface of their own by their steepness (`floor_surfaces`, `ceiling_surfaces`). The mouth to the east is the cave's whole section (`width: full, height: full`): it follows floor and roof along the wall, bank and lean included.

rooms.name: The gully beyond its mouth
rooms.notes: The gully's other half; and a ramp that hangs: a slab 16 thick under a sloping top (`thickness` with `top_slope`), from 16 over the floor up to the landing at 96, its underside with a surface of its own (`bottom_surface`). In its east wall, on the bank, an arch (open:gully_arch): its sill is level on the passage's floor at its south side and rakes up the bank to the north, its sides end 192 and its point stands 272 above the sill's lowest point.

ceiling_surfaces.notes: An L traced on the level ceiling over the start (points all at its height, a line round it): its faces carry the secret flag, so a perceptive party sees them pulse; stepping on plate:hall_mark clears it (the Abandoned Temple's walkway traced on hall 8's ceiling).

rooms.name: Hollow whose floor is one plane, not square to any wall
rooms.notes: An uneven floor: `floor_plane` rises to the south-east, and `floor_points` make the sills level at the three mouths. Rough walls follow the floor; the roof (`ceiling_points`) has its crown off centre and one low corner. A rock island and a block stand on the slope.

rooms.name: Hollow with a level floor and banks up to its walls
rooms.notes: A level floor at 144 whose banks rise to the walls at 304, as the caverns of Castle Darkmoor are made: `floor_points` at the corners and round the level part, `floor_lines` along the banks' foot. The south and north banks are walked; the east one is a rock bank too steep to walk (`steep_floor`). The roof comes down to the walls from a crown (`ceiling_points`).

rooms.name: Cell behind two leaves that fold against their jambs
rooms.notes: Its doorway is its whole south wall, 512 wide, with the seal cell 32 beside it: leaves that slid into the wall would stand in that cell.

rooms.name: Hall of door leaves
rooms.notes: Doors by their leaves: two that fold against their jambs with a picture each (north-west), a seal in four quarters over two folding leaves (north-east), a lower and an upper half that pass each other (east), a leaf that opens part of its way with its picture tiled (west), and a leaf of two pictures, the right one mirrored (south, to the cell of the double door).

rooms.name: Cell behind a leaf that opens part of its way
Cell behind a lower and an upper half that pass each other
Cell behind a seal in four quarters

beams.notes: A raking beam with a level top: its underside climbs from 300 to 400 while its top stays at 480 (the Abandoned Temple's box walls over its ramps).

rooms.name: Cell behind two leaves that part sideways
Room of wall panels under a lean-to ceiling
rooms.notes: Panels cut into the walls: a bookcase panel between corner strips on the north wall (whose top rakes), a fitted full-height panel and a wooden one from the floor on the south wall, a sign over the door on the west wall. The panels take the place of the dado band.

rooms.name: Pit under the bridge that grows
Rig of things that ride and of movers at the room's limits
rooms.notes: A lever on a post (a switch whose `block` is a platform) opens a gate of two halves: the lower sinks into the floor, the upper rises into the ceiling. Behind it a deck rises with its two posts (`parts`), a chest that stands on it (`rides`) and the button on its side that sends it (`block`); a button in the south wall is pushed 8 into the wall.

rooms.name: Shrine under a pyramid with a lantern on it
rooms.notes: Ceiling levels one on another: a pyramid roof over the whole room (brick on its leaning sides, by `edge`; without it they take the ceiling's surface), a lantern drum standing on the pyramid's flat top (its outline is that top's own points) and a small pointed cap inside the drum's top. A slab hangs 80 above the floor in the south-west corner: one chest stands on it, one under it (`floor_height`), and a flight ends on its edge. In the floor: the stairwell of twelve steps (26 points) and a hole whose corners lie exactly 16 from the crypt's walls.

rooms.name: Crypt under the shrine
rooms.notes: Reached by the stairwell. The hole in its ceiling has two corners exactly 16 from its walls. The beam is the haunch of an arch: it meets the ceiling with its low end and is cut level there.

rooms.name: Steps under a coffered ceiling
rooms.notes: A raised ceiling level over a stepped floor.

rooms.name: Twelve steps down from the shrine
Cell behind a door that slides sideways
Cell behind a door that opens from one side only, with a guard that appears when it opens

platforms.notes: A screen from wall to wall that the keg's event makes passable and repaints (effects `passable`, `set_texture`).

rooms.name: Cell behind two leaves that part up and down
Room under a ceiling that rises twice its run
Trench, funnel and mound
rooms.notes: Levels with banks: a trench with sloping long sides and upright ends, a funnel whose four sides slope down to a small floor, and a mound (a raised level whose sides slope).

rooms.name: Tube under a ridge ceiling
rooms.notes: The two end walls stand up to the ridge: the openings in them rise above the eaves (416) into the gable ends.

rooms.name: Six-sided tunnel
rooms.notes: A path room with a `section` (the Hive's tunnel: floor 128 wide, 256 wide at half height, ceiling 128 wide) and a height at each path point: level, a ramp of 128, a mitred bend, level again. A doorway in each side: in the level stretch (south) and in the climbing one (north), where it stands level on the floor at its higher jamb.

rooms.name: Tube with banks
rooms.notes: The Control Center's tube: banks that rise 74 over 90 (walked up), upright walls, chamfers. The ceiling runs from 689 to 753 along the tube: the section's top follows it, its sides stay. Shut at its far end by a wall of the section's shape.

rooms.name: Cell at the tunnel's square end
Tunnel hall
rooms.notes: The tunnel's mouth in its east wall has the tunnel's own six-sided shape (`shape: section`): the wall is cut round it, with no lintel and no jambs.

rooms.name: Tunnel to the cell
rooms.notes: Joined to the six-sided tunnel end to end, open over the whole section. Its far end is square (`section.end`): the sides run from the section to a plain rectangle that is all doorway.

rooms.name: Vaulted passage off the gully
rooms.notes: A vault by a whole-ceiling level: walls to 608, leaning sides 64 in to a flat crown at 672, upright ends. Its north end is open over the vault's whole profile (open:vault_run_apse: `width: full, height: full, trim_to_wall: true`). The flight ends in that doorway, on the apse's floor (`to` on the wall, `to_height` the sill): four risers, three treads here, the last riser in the wall.

rooms.name: Passage with a wall section that slides into a pocket
Loft at the head of the wedge
Blocks with sloping tops
rooms.notes: A wedge that is a ramp up to a doorway 128 above the floor (`top_slope`), a raking buttress against the south wall (too steep to walk: `steep_floor`), a block with a height at each corner (`top_heights`), and two landings one above the other: a flight climbs to the lower one (`to_height`), and one that is open underneath leaves it (`from_height`, `open_below`).

rooms.name: Works hall of moving parts
rooms.notes: The hub of the moving parts: sideways and two-leaf doors to the north, a gate block, a plate and a carrying block to the south-east, a thin lift through a floor hole and a wall section that slides away to the south, the bridges over the pits to the west.

rooms.name: Workshop of handles and chests

panels.notes: A secret panel: it pulses for a party with Perception (`secret`).

platforms.notes: A desk whose top an event changes alone (`set_texture` with `face: top`), laid from u 32 (`offset`) as Castle Darkmoor's podium shows its paper sheet.

rooms.notes: The interactive things as the shipped maps build them (2026-11-13): a lever on the west wall and one on a post (small handles that move as doors), a push button on the east wall, a plate whose picture follows its state, an MM6 chest (end, middle and end) and an MM7 chest with a sloping lid, a lift that starts raised with a monster on its top, and a pool of lava that does not burn (`kind: liquid`).

openings.notes: A two-sided frame: hvtrim1 toward the works, swhz3dk toward the cell, changing at the middle of the wall where the leaves stand.

doors.notes: Its leaves' free edges show swr4dk at their size (`edge_surface`), as Control Center's doors' edges do.
Slides right, away from door:pair: both leaves of the pier between them would not fit in it (each goes 2 past its jamb, into the wall).
A door with an event for each side of its leaf (wiring `side`): it opens from room:leaf_pass_cell only; from inside the cell it says that it will not budge.

lifts.notes: Starts raised: the monster over it stands on its top (328), not on the floor under it.

movers.notes: A bridge that slides sideways with its kerbs: at its start it lies along the south wall of the pit and joins nothing; at its end it lies between the two mouths. It stops 1 short of each wall: its ends in the walls' planes would lie over the next rooms' wall faces (those walls have no thickness) and flicker.
A gate block from wall to wall and floor to ceiling: it sinks into the floor (its top ends 2 below it).
A bridge that grows: a stub at the east mouth whose west end face travels 448 to the far mouth.
A button that is pushed into its wall: at its end it stands 8 inside the south wall, where it is hidden.
A deck that rises with what stands on it: two posts (parts of the mover), a chest and the button on its east side.
The gate's upper half: it rises through the ceiling (256) and is hidden above it, its underside 2 over the ceiling's plane (in it the two would flicker).
The gate's lower half: it sinks into the floor.
A block that travels sideways and up at once and carries the party: from the passage floor to the ledge of the room behind it.
A wall section from wall to wall and floor to ceiling that slides into the pocket beside the passage and comes back by itself.

plates.notes: Stepped on, it clears the secret flag of the hall's traced ceiling and sets it on itself (wiring `secret`, `clear_secret`).
A water plate with the fluid bit (`liquid: water`), as the shipped water faces have it.
A secret plate without an event: a perceptive party sees it pulse (the Abandoned Temple's plates round its heads).
The Forge's fire floor (no liquid of the shader's) laid as a liquid that flows (`liquid: liquid`, `flow: right`): it ripples and runs east.
Stepped on, it gives one scroll of three at random, twice at most (a count in a condition, `give_item` with `one_of`).
A plate in a tunnel: the flat floor's whole width between two lines square across the way (here 192 to 352 along the stretch after the bend).

floors.notes: Lava's picture (lavatyl) on the fluid bit alone: it does not burn.

switches.notes: A plate on the lectern's sloping top, in the top's plane (as Goblinwatch's console lays its sixteen).
A button on the side of a mover: it rides with the deck.
A lever on a post: a switch on the side of a platform that has an id.
MM7's push button: a block 16 out of the wall, pushed in and back out by its event (toggles).
The Forge's lever: a post and an arm that sinks 16 and rises again (its event toggles the lift).
A plate whose picture follows its state: used (t1swdu) and back (t1swdd).
A lever on a post whose event has a condition and else_effects: its arm follows the branch.

chests.notes: A desk: a chest whose top has a surface of its own (`top_surface`).

A chest whose rolls each have a treasure level of their own (`random_levels`), after one fixed item (2148, a letter): written as the game's own chest record. The first opening shows it; later ones show chest:fold_spent in the same box.
A second set of contents for the box of chest:fold_hoard (`box_of`): its event opens this one with `open_chest` once the hoard has been seen.
A chest on a mover: it stands on the deck's top and rides up with it.
MM6's chest ch3: end, middle and end on its long sides, ch3side on its ends, and MM6's other lid (`lid: v`: ch3tplev, ch3tpbv, ch3tprev) as the Forge's carved chest has it.
MM7's chest with a sloping lid, 80 high.

spawns.notes: An item spawn point: one roll of treasure level 3 when the map is first entered (nothing, gold or an item). In group 51, as MM7's shipped spawn records are (it does nothing on an item spawn point).

monsters.notes: A monster placed at its post: by its name in monster_data.txt, peaceful by the project's word (its kind is hostile: the build's load event clears the Hostile bit of group 7) and keeping its place.
Starts invisible (`hidden`) and appears when the door opens ({show_actors: 77}); carries item 1, a longsword (`carries`), which it leaves when it dies.
Over the lift that starts raised: it stands on the lift's top.

items.notes: An item lying on the floor from the start; the walk picks it up.

decorations.notes: A decoration as an event's source: clicked, it runs evt:sided_keg.
A crystal on the desk; the desk's event turns its picture to its empty stand (`set_sprite`).

events.text: The gallery of shapes lies before you.

events.title: Chest
events.notes: One chest of two: the hoard the first time, the second contents after.
The traced ceiling stops pulsing; the plate starts.

events.title: Door that opens part of its way
Door of a lower and an upper half

effects.text: The plate on the lectern clicks.
A bolt of fire leaps along the wall.

events.text: The plate sinks and a door grinds open.

effects.text: The podium is cold to the touch.

events.title: Button
events.text: The button sinks into the wall.

effects.lua: if IsAtLeast(MapVar(seal_draws), 2) then evt.StatusText("The seal is spent.") end

events.notes: Runs when the party leaves the map (`trigger: leave`).

effects.text: The vault's air shimmers with heat.
The heat of the vault burns you.

events.title: Desk
events.notes: The desk's top alone turns to deskside and the crystal on it to its empty stand, as Castle Darkmoor's podium and crystal.

error.message: nothing in the project has the sub-object room:cave/pillars/pillar9 (a sub-object is named by its owner's id and the path of keys, as room:hall/pillars/pillar2)
